## Install / Download

1. Download **Unbored.Companion_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe** below (the file ending in `-setup.exe`).
2. Run it. Windows may say it protected your PC, because the installer is not signed yet: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. The Companion finds World of Warcraft and puts Wisp into the game. Start the game and click Wisp.

Already installed? Nothing to do: the Companion updates itself, and Wisp with it. More help in the [README](https://github.com/hmbanan666/wow-unbored#install).

**No Windows, or prefer doing it by hand?** Download **Unbored-v{{VERSION}}.zip** below, unzip it into `World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/` so there is an `Unbored` folder inside, and start the game. Wisp still makes quick plans, adds tips to item tooltips, and answers common questions. Fuller answers and full plans need the Companion.

<details><summary>Other files here (you can ignore them)</summary>

- `.msi`: the same installer, for PCs managed by IT.
- `.sig` and `latest.json`: used by the Companion to update itself. Ignore them.
- `release.json`: for addon managers. Ignore it.

</details>
